about.lead: To me, code quality and interface clarity are
about.leadAccent: two sides of the same craft.
about.body: A fullstack developer finishing my Computer Science degree, I build products end to end — from the data model to the interface. My projects are there to show it, not just promise it. With my company backing me for what's next, I'm now looking for a school to take that standard further, in an engineering or master's program.
about.fact2: Apprenticeship — company on board for what's next
about.fact3: Aiming for an engineering or master's track
